key_results: Gaze driven by perceived authenticity rather than actual authenticity; awareness of AI generation triggers anomaly search
comments: Eye-tracking study on 40 participants reveals important human-centered insight; limited sample size and video diversity suggest need for larger cross-cultural study.

model_io.model: Eye-tracking + gaze analysis during video understanding/detection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Perceived authenticity, not actual authenticity, drives gaze patterns during AI-video analysis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mere awareness of AI potential alters consumption from passive to active anomaly search

title: Invariant state modelling for robust adaptive intrusion detection in software-defined internet of things environments
task: Adaptive intrusion detection in SD-IoT with invariant state modeling
key_results: 99.8% accuracy, 99.5% precision, 99.8% recall, 99.7% F1; outperforms EWA baseline
comments: Dual-objective optimization with EVT-based calibration is principled; however, evaluation on proprietary SD-IoT testbeds limits reproducibility.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Invariant state transition modeling captures SD-IoT non-stationary attack patterns better than fixed feature spaces
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 99.8% accuracy and robust rare-event detection

title: Energy-efficient secure routing in wireless sensor networks using fuzzy inference clustering and attention-based multi-scale deep learning
task: Energy-efficient secure routing in WSN with intrusion detection
key_results: Energy 1.02 J, throughput 0.93 Mbps, delay 4.0 ms, attack detection 98%
comments: Multi-objective optimization combining FIS clustering, ATSPCP trust, and EMSD-MobileNet is comprehensive; real deployment scalability on heterogeneous hardware remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fuzzy inference with bio-inspired optimization outperforms fixed clustering and routing in energy efficiency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 1.02 J consumption and 98% attack detection rate achieved

title: Risk-sensitive mean-field control of large-scale UAV Swarms for stochastic disaster tracking and robust first response
task: Risk-sensitive mean-field control of UAV swarms for disaster tracking
key_results: Distributed consensus on mean-field equilibrium; superior coverage efficiency, energy, connectivity vs. baselines
comments: Risk-sensitive entropy-dual formulation with distributed computation is theoretically rigorous; real-world deployment on large swarms and sensor-communication constraints need further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Risk-sensitive mean-field approximation enables scalable distributed control for large UAV swarms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior efficiency and robustness to disturbance variance

title: Privacy-aware distributed intelligence with tokenized trust for low-latency task offloading in 6G vehicular edge networks
task: Privacy-aware distributed intelligence for 6G vehicular edge computing
key_results: 30-40% latency reduction, 25% task completion improvement, 95% malicious node detection, gradient-based privacy
comments: Federated learning + blockchain trust is principled for privacy-preserving V2V edge computing; however, evaluation limited to simulation; real 6G network deployment absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Federated learning preserves vehicle privacy while enabling collaborative task offloading prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 30-40% latency reduction with privacy preservation

title: High-fidelity CNN-based surrogate modeling for wildfire spread forecasting
task: CNN-based wildfire spread forecasting
key_results: F1 score of 0.92; prediction in fraction of second
comments: High efficiency comes at potential cost of spatial granularity; real deployment requires integration with operational fire systems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning surrogates can achieve real-time high-resolution fire predictions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with F1=0.92 on held-out test data

title: Learning multi-granularity skeleton representations via hierarchical graph contrastive learning
task: Skeleton-based action recognition via hierarchical graph contrastive learning
key_results: UCF101: 91.2% Top-1 (3.9% gain); HMDB51: 66.8% (5.3% gain); 1% few-shot: 21.6% improvement
comments: Topology-constrained augmentation and multi-granularity contrastive objectives elegantly address joint confidence; strong few-shot results suggest robust representation learning.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-granularity contrastive learning balances local motion and holistic action semantics better than single-scale approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 3.9-5.3% accuracy gains and strong few-shot generalization

title: IR-WSANet: A lightweight network with frequency-spatial joint optimization for infrared small target detection
task: Infrared small target detection with frequency-spatial optimization
key_results: mAP 97.2%-82.8% on SIDD/HIT-UAV; 2.8-14.1% improvement over YOLOv10; F1 improvement 14.8%
comments: DWaveletConv and multi-band decomposition address noise well; lightweight design (27.9 GFLOPs, 42.8 FPS) enables real-time deployment but generalization to other IR modalities untested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frequency-spatial joint optimization suppresses noise and improves small-target localization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2.8-14.1% mAP gain over baseline; high F1 improvement

title: Numerical simulation of productivity evaluation for multi-cluster fracturing in horizontal wells considering non-uniform proppant placement within fractures
task: Productivity evaluation for multi-cluster fracturing in horizontal wells
key_results: Cumulative production mismatch <8% vs. ECLIPSE; identifies permeability-dependent parameter sensitivity
comments: Fully coupled framework (fracture propagation + proppant transport + production) is comprehensive; dynamic conductivity evolution based on closure stress and proppant concentration is realistic.

inputs: pumping parameters (sand injection, rate, viscosity, concentration)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-uniform proppant placement effects on conductivity are best captured by real-time dynamic updates
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; <8% cumulative production error vs. commercial simulator

title: Robust displacement estimation from filament-based soft sensors using a parallel attention-enhanced LSTM for rehabilitation monitoring
task: Soft sensor displacement estimation from filament-based tactile sensors
key_results: RMSE 0.047, MAE 0.028, R² 0.963; outperforms LSTM, GRU, CNN-LSTM baselines
comments: PA-LSTM architecture elegantly combines temporal encoding with adaptive attention; real-time deployment on wearables requires further latency benchmarking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parallel attention-enhanced LSTM better captures nonlinear soft-sensor dynamics than sequential baselines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant RMSE, MAE, R² improvements

title: Predicting drilling fluid lost circulation volume and radius using petrophysical well logs and machine learning approaches
task: Lost circulation prediction in drilling via hybrid MLP-KAN
key_results: Hybrid MLP-KAN R²=0.9445, RMSE=0.0143; identifies three invasion zones; KAN/MLP alone R²≈0.90-0.91
comments: Hybrid architecture and SHAP feature analysis provide interpretability; field-scale validation on single Iranian oil field limits generalization to other basins.

inputs: drilling parameters (mud weight, bit size, rate)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Kolmogorov-Arnold networks complement MLP representations for nonlinear mud invasion modeling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; hybrid R²=0.9445 > standalone MLP (0.9054) and KAN (0.9075)

title: Feature extraction of rolling bearings in cow dung briquetting machine based on CEEMDAN-WTD-DBO
task: Rolling bearing fault feature extraction in noisy agricultural machinery
key_results: SNR improvement from -15 dB to -1.4 dB; MSE reduced to 0.002152; extracted 8.5 Hz fault frequency
comments: CEEMDAN-WTD-DBO fusion is effective for extreme noise but validation limited to single machine type; broader agricultural equipment applicability unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: DBO-optimized adaptive thresholding outperforms fixed thresholding under -15 dB SNR
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves -1.4 dB output SNR and clear fault signature extraction

title: Sample-efficient estimation of nonlinear quantum state functions
task: Sample-efficient estimation of nonlinear quantum state functions
key_results: O(n/ε²) sample complexity for degree-n polynomial functions; entropy/fidelity applications achieve Õ(γ²/(ε²κ))
comments: Quantum state function framework via linear combination of unitaries is theoretically novel; practical quantum hardware implementation and fault tolerance limits remain open.

model_io.model: Quantum state function framework (swap test extension)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Linear combination of unitaries enables nonlinear state function estimation without block-encoding or purified queries
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Õ(γ²/(ε²κ)) sample complexity achieved for entropy and fidelity

title: Towards universal urban patterns-of-life simulation
task: Universal urban mobility simulation
key_results: Normalized similarity score >0.80 across most cities; scales to 20M+ agents
comments: Agent-based models capture emergent behavior well but validation relies on aggregated survey data; fine-grained trajectory validation lacking.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Activity schedules emerge from mandatory and flexible activity interplay without city-specific calibration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; similarity scores >0.80 on unseen cities

title: Superballistic flow of viscous electron fluid induced by edge magnetoplasmons in point contacts
task: Investigate superballistic electron flow in 2D electron gas point contacts under microwave excitation
key_results: Positive photoconductivity at weak microwave power confirms superballistic flow; negative photoconductivity at strong power indicates enhanced phonon scattering
comments: The photoconductivity measurements provide indirect evidence; direct observation of viscous flow signatures would strengthen claims.

model_io.model: 2D electron gas point contact under microwave irradiation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Edge magnetoplasmons drive superballistic transport at low magnetic fields
hypotheses.result: Positive photoconductivity observed confirming superballistic regime

title: Correlated singular flat bands on the surface pentagonal lattice of ferromagnetic CoS2
task: Observe singular flat bands on pentagonal surface lattice of ferromagnetic CoS₂
key_results: First observation of singular flat bands with band crossings on 2D pentagonal lattice; non-Fermi liquid behavior with linear temperature-dependent scattering rate
comments: Surface states are inherently fragile; the coupling mechanism between surface flat bands and bulk topological states deserves further investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: 2D pentagonal lattice on CoS₂ surface hosts singular flat bands
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coupling between surface flat bands and bulk topological bands produces non-Fermi liquid behavior
hypotheses.result: Linear temperature dependence of quasiparticle scattering rate observed

title: Revealing hidden periodicity in momentum-encoded metasurfaces
task: Reveal hidden periodicity in momentum-encoded metasurfaces using geometric framework
key_results: Derived commensurability conditions enabling representation as compact periodic superlattices; experimentally demonstrated valley addressability in photonic crystal slabs
comments: The Moiré lattice interpretation is elegant but relies on detecting periodicity in inherently aperiodic structures, which may have resolution limits in practice.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hidden periodicity exists in aperiodic momentum-encoded structures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via commensurability conditions and supercell representation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-local metasurfaces exhibit valley-addressable character
hypotheses.result: Validated experimentally using photonic crystal slabs

title: Single atom iron promotes CS hydrogenation on interstellar grain analogues
task: Model CS hydrogenation on silica-supported single-atom iron catalyst for astrochemistry
key_results: CS hydrogenation to H₂CS is kinetically accessible at low temperature via tunneling; further hydrogenation to CH₃SH hindered by high barrier, requires T > 100 K
comments: DFT accuracy for transition state barriers is typically ±0.1–0.2 eV; interstellar grain morphology variations could substantially alter kinetics.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fe–H–Si cooperative motif assists H₂ dissociation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via DFT; enables low-barrier CS hydrogenation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tunneling contributes significantly to CS hydrogenation at low temperature
hypotheses.result: Kinetic modeling indicates tunneling makes reactivity accessible below classical threshold

title: Deterministic roll-contact printing of ultradense aligned nanowire arrays for high-performance flexible electronics
task: Develop roll-contact printing method for assembling aligned ZnO nanowire arrays at ultrahigh densities on flexible substrates
key_results: Record density of 14 NWs/µm with high alignment; UV photodetectors achieve responsivity 4000 A W⁻¹ and survive 5000 bending cycles (10 mm radius) and 5000 twisting cycles (±25°)
comments: The deterministic contact roll-printing is scalable, but yield uniformity and nanowire surface quality after transfer require process optimization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Travelling line contact reduces mechanical stress while enabling high-density, aligned NW transfer
hypotheses.result: Achieved record density of 14 NWs/µm with controlled alignment and minimal contamination

hypotheses.hypothesis: Device performance scales systematically with printed NW density
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; responsivity increases and reaches 4000 A W⁻¹ at highest density

title: Integrated high-quality multi-wavelength quantum light source compatible with ITU Channel Grid
task: Demonstrate multi-wavelength quantum light source based on periodically poled thin-film lithium niobate microring compatible with ITU grid
key_results: 12 photon-pair wavelengths at 100-GHz FSR; photon-pair generation rate 817 MHz/mW; brightness 1.86×10⁹ Hz/mW²/GHz; coincidence-to-accidental ratio 51,829; g²(0)=0.015 for heralded singles; 99.5% energy-time entanglement visibility
comments: Integration with ITU channels is key for scalable networks; phase stability and wavelength tunability under thermal drift need monitoring.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TFLN microring SPDC generates high-brightness multi-wavelength entangled photons with low noise
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CAR >50,000 and g²(0)~0.015 demonstrate high quality; 99.5% entanglement visibility

title: Thermal quench dynamics of visons in gapless Kitaev spin liquid
task: Study nonequilibrium relaxation dynamics of visons in gapless Kitaev spin liquid following thermal quench
key_results: Vison dynamics cross from diffusion-limited annihilation to terminal-velocity kinetics to dynamical arrest; long-lived √3×√3 vison crystals form at low T, suppressing further annihilation
comments: Kinetic Monte Carlo capture of vison diffusion is elegant, but experimental detection of these elusive excitations in real materials remains a major challenge.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temperature-dependent vison dynamics exhibit multiple relaxation regimes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; diffusion-limited → terminal-velocity → dynamical arrest observed with decreasing T

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metastable √3×√3 vison crystals suppress annihilation through emergent Z₃ symmetry
hypotheses.result: Verified via kinetic Monte Carlo; hidden coarsening dynamics of vison superclusters observed

title: A Multimodal Dataset of Full-Body Kinematics and Kinetics from Laboratory- and Wearable-Based Systems
task: Develop multimodal biomechanical dataset combining laboratory and wearable measurement systems
key_results: Comprehensive synchronized dataset from 12 healthy adults covering static postures, treadmill walking/running at multiple speeds/inclines, and functional tasks; includes raw signals and derived biomechanical variables from four systems
comments: Rich dataset enables wearable validation and ML training, but lacks clinical/pathological populations and real-world environmental complexity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synchronized multimodal data enables validation of wearable sensors against laboratory gold standards
hypotheses.result: Dataset structure supports direct comparison of OMC vs. IMC and instrumented treadmill vs. insole measurements

title: The effect of rotor airflow from plant protection UAV on pesticide application in rice
task: Optimize rotor airflow effects on pesticide droplet deposition in rice crop spraying via UAV
key_results: Flight speeds 3–4 m/s enable optimal overlap between canopy disturbance and droplet deposition zones; higher speeds cause drift and reduced efficacy (spray efficiency reduction ~30–50%)
comments: Integration of aerial imagery, machine vision, and CFD simulation is methodologically sound, but results are crop and weather-dependent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rotor-induced canopy disturbance and droplet deposition zones must overlap for efficacy
hypotheses.result: Optimal overlap achieved at 3–4 m/s; efficiency drops 30–50% at higher speeds

title: Comparative DFT investigation of 1T and 2H phase Janus TaSSe monolayers as potential sensors for toxic gas molecules
task: Comparative DFT study of 1T vs. 2H Janus TaSSe monolayers as toxic gas sensors
key_results: 1T phase thermodynamically stable; AsH₃ highest adsorption energy (−2.4 eV on Se-site of 1T); 1T exhibits stronger gas–surface interactions; physisorption via van der Waals (no chemical bonds); 1T recovery times >10⁵ s for AsH₃ at 500 K, 2H shows <10⁴ s
comments: DFT results are consistent across metrics, but experimental validation on actual monolayers and practical sensor fabrication remain open.

inputs: Toxic gas molecules (AsH₃, H₂S, NH₃, COCl₂, O₃, PH₃)

hypotheses.hypothesis: 1T phase exhibits stronger gas adsorption and thermodynamic stability than 2H
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 1T phase shows higher adsorption energies and stronger interactions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adsorption mechanism is physisorption via van der Waals interactions without chemical bond formation
hypotheses.result: Verified via CDD, ELF, and RDG analysis

title: A hardware-efficient Berkeley gate for superconducting quantum processors
task: Benchmark hardware-efficient Berkeley gate on superconducting quantum processor under realistic noise
key_results: Subspace confinement probability 95.96% on hardware vs. 100% simulation; simulated process fidelity 98.23%, hardware fidelity 91.76%; discrepancy attributed to qubit relaxation, dephasing, SPAM errors
comments: The 7% fidelity drop from simulation to hardware is substantial; state-of-the-art error mitigation techniques could improve this.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hardware-efficient Berkeley gate produces target entangled state with high fidelity on NISQ devices
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 95.96% subspace confinement and 91.76% process fidelity achieved

hypotheses.hypothesis: Qubit relaxation, dephasing, and SPAM errors account for ~7% fidelity loss
hypotheses.result: Verified via process tomography and noise characterization

title: Time–temperature superposition of silicone rubber embedded with irregular-shaped magnetic particles under different magnetic fields
task: Characterize thermomechanical dynamic viscoelastic properties of magnetorheological elastomer with irregular iron particles
key_results: Temperature 30–70°C causes 12.5% decrease in storage modulus G' and 67% increase in loss modulus G'' for silicone; MRE shows 18.9% G' reduction and 4% G'' increase; dual sensitivity to temperature and magnetic field demonstrated
comments: Flake-shaped particles offer higher aspect ratios than spherical carbonyls, but manufacturing consistency and particle alignment under field remain practical concerns.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Irregular flake-shaped iron particles provide higher initial stiffness than spherical particles
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; G' reduction rate above threshold T exceeds that of conventional MREs

title: Large-amplitude polar electromechanical coupling in ferroelectric fluids
task: Demonstrate large-amplitude electromechanical transduction in ferroelectric fluids
key_results: Forces exceeding micronewtons (>1000× larger than non-lamellar fluids); ferroelectric lamellar order enhances topological forces
comments: The three-order-of-magnitude improvement is remarkable, but scaling to practical device integration remains unexplored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ferroelectric lamellar order enhances local topological forces beyond piconewton scale
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated forces exceeding micronewtons through topology-deformation coupling
